name: MMRotate
description: We present an open-source toolbox, named MMRotate, which provides a coherent algorithm framework of training, inferring, and evaluation for the popular rotated object detection algorithm based on deep learning. MMRotate implements 18 state-of-the-art algorithms and supports the three most frequently used angle definition methods. To facilitate future research and industrial applications of rotated object detection-related problems, we also provide a large number of trained models and detailed benchmarks to give insights into the performance of rotated object detection. MMRotate is publicly released at https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmrotate.
typical_sota_score: varies by dataset (commonly ~60–90% mAP depending on benchmark)
reputation: Well-regarded and widely used within the OpenMMLab community for rotated object detection research and benchmarking.
notes: Non-LLM computer-vision benchmark/toolbox; results strongly depend on dataset and angle-encoding conventions; provides many pretrained models but may have dataset-specific overfitting risks.
